svg.title: Loading a sponge with two colors, in five pictures. 1: wet the sponge and squeeze it until it is only damp. 2: rub the left half of the sponge on yellow and the right half on pink, side by side. 3: dab it on the plate a few times so the colors meet softly in the middle. 4: dab it on the paper, then dab a little left and right over the middle. Done: a smooth blend from yellow to pink with a soft overlap zone.
